title: clausena nana
intro: Clausena nana, commonly known as Thai plume or Thai tea, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae, native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing fever, inflammation, and improving digestion, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Clausena nana involve its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, and its potential antiseptic and antibacterial properties, which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Clausena nana include flavonoids, limonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and medicinal uses.
